articleTitle: Issues with Flicker Detection and Elimination for Power Distribution Networks in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this article, an actual problem related to the quality of electrical energy is considered. A model is proposed for grouping the causes of flicker in distribution networks. A study on user problems caused by the flicker phenomenon is presented. An algorithm for locating, assessment and eliminating the causes of flicker is proposed.

articleTitle: Methodology for Strategic Planning of The National Energy Industry (Ivited Paper)
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The world, Europe and Bulgaria are going through a Grand Transition towards dedicated goals for 2050, and the respective energy economies are going through a Grand Energy Transition. Planning these transitions is a supreme science that predetermines the future of the planet by investing huge human, material and financial resources. The paper presents basic concepts and the arrangement of knowledge contained in the recently published monographic book “Methodology for strategic planning of the national energy industry”. The book is one of the products of the project “Scientific Methodology and Mathematical Models for Development Planning of the National Energy System”, financed by the “National Science Fund” of Bulgaria.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Fuzzy Logic Control of a Buck DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The manuscript presents a synthesis of control of Buck DC-DC converter, by using a fuzzy controller. The individual steps of the control synthesis are successively presented, as well as the implementation of the controller in Matlab/Simulink. After the control synthesis, the various possibilities of the fuzzy functions were examined and on this basis the most suitable ones for the purposes of the study were determined. In this way, a practice-oriented methodology for control synthesis is given, which is useful in view of both power electronics training and the needs of designing and prototyping power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Creating A Web-Based Platform For Programming Humanoid Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This research project focuses on the design and implementation of a web-based programming platform designed for Misty humanoid robots. Misty robots possess advanced capabilities, and to fully utilize their potential, a user-friendly and accessible programming environment is essential. The proposed platform aims to streamline the development process, enabling both novice and experienced developers to create custom applications and behaviors for Misty robots. This research involves the design and implementation of a secure and scalable architecture, integration of essential sensor data and hardware interfaces, and the development of a comprehensive software development kit. The platform's versatility will empower developers to explore new possibilities in the field of humanoid robotics, contributing to advancements in robotics research, education, and commercial applications.

articleTitle: Co-simulation: What Approach for Power Grids and ICT Networks?
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Information and Communication Technologies have massively integrated power grids, now known as smart grids. It is becoming difficult to dimension. The idea behind co-simulation is to be able to preview the behavior of the smart grid's physical and functional architecture before it is implemented. This article analyzes the review of co-simulation platforms for power grids and technology and communications networks used in smart grids, to highlight a method for implementing a co-simulation solution. The PSSE simulator as an electrical simulator and OMNET++ as a communication network simulator are proposed to be integrated with the Mosaïk system. The working environment for the co-simulator realization will be the Python language.

articleTitle: Dataset and Electric Load Forecasting at Residential Level: Case of the City of Lome
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The regulation and self-sufficiency of electrical energy still remains a challenge in some regions for the residential sector. The aim of this study is to determine a prediction model adapted to each category of consumer, taking into account the parameters that make up the electricity network. With this in mind, this work is based on a set of data collected in West Africa, in Togo and more specifically in the city of Lomé, over a period of 1 year 6 months, on the electricity consumption habits of 10 residential properties with characteristics as diverse as unpredictable and the frequency of appearance of certain uncontrollable events. The data were grouped into 2 groups of 5 houses on the basis of the similarity of the parameters characterizing the data. Group 1 has a high rate of load shedding and a relatively low average total electrical load, while Group 2 has little or no-load shedding. The data were processed in two models, one based on Wavelet decomposition hybridized with artificial neural networks and the other based on Kalman hybridized with neural networks. The results show that the Wavelet-neural network (WANN) model is best suited to Group 1, while the Kalman-neural network (KANN) model is best suited to Group 2.

articleTitle: Python-Based Modeling and Simulation of a Transformerless DC/DC Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This report presents a Python-based approach for modeling and simulating transformerless DC/DC converters. The primary focus is on designing and analyzing the performance of these converters in various operating conditions. By leveraging Python's numerical libraries, such as NumPy and SciPy, a detailed mathematical model of the converter is developed. The simulation environment allows for real-time visualization and analysis of key parameters, including voltage, current, and efficiency. The proposed method offers a flexible and efficient alternative to traditional simulation tools, making it suitable for rapid prototyping and optimization of power electronic systems. The results highlight the accuracy and scalability of Python in simulating complex converter dynamics without the need for transformer-based topologies.

articleTitle: Technical and Managerial Prerequisites for Increase Effectiveness of Communication of Sales Promotion with Advanced Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper explores the use of artificial intelligence, such as chatbots, to improve communication models and meet customer needs, while recognising the continued importance of human interaction. It delves into the optimization of multi-channel management to facilitate the coordination of diverse communication channels, as insurance products evolve from in-person to digital sales. Overall, the paper explores how business engineering and AI can improve communication models to satisfy customers, with a nuanced perspective on the automation of human roles.

articleTitle: Challenges to Ensuring Information Security and the Role of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper examines the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in addressing contemporary cybersecurity challenges. The digital age's expanding data landscape and evolving cyber threats have rendered traditional security measures inadequate. AI emerges as a critical tool, capable of analyzing vast datasets, detecting anomalies, and adapting to new threats in real-time. The study explores the history and evolution of AI, focusing on its applications in intrusion detection, malware analysis, and predictive analytics. Challenges such as adversarial exploitation, algorithmic biases, and implementation complexities are also discussed. Future prospects emphasize enhancing AI accuracy, transparency, and collaboration with emerging technologies like IoT and quantum computing. The findings underscore AI's transformative potential in cybersecurity while highlighting the need for ethical and robust implementation.

articleTitle: Methodology for Research the Logistics Activities Outsourcing Impact on Logistics Service Performance in the Bulgarian Context
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents a research methodology designed to evaluate the influence of outsourcing the main logistics activities on the logistics service performance of Bulgarian manufacturing SMEs. Using a quantitative research design, the study aims to assess and analyse the impact degree of outsourcing each logistics activity on improving logistics performance. Logistics service performance is evaluated by asking respondents to estimate the logistics performance on four delivery perspectives - speed, reliability, flexibility, and cost. Respondents are also asked to rate the impact of outsourcing each logistics activity on its performance indicators. Through this research methodology, valuable insights can be obtained that contribute to understanding logistics outsourcing practices and the expectations of their impact on the service and performance of logistics of outsourcing firms.

articleTitle: Integrating ICT Into Electro-Energy Systems: What Network Topology for Reliable Interdependence with the Power Grid in the Context of Smart Grids?
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Information and communication technologies (ICTs) are deployed for monitoring and management of the electricity grid. However, their physical or cybernetic infrastructure can have an impact on power system reliability, and vice versa. A mature integration of ICTs can therefore increase the reliability of the interdependence of these two networks. This article aims to review these interdependencies, highlighting the impact of ICT failures on the reliability of the electricity system. The resulting analysis will suggest an approach for ICT infrastructure in the context of the smart grid, with the aim of improving the reliability of the electricity system..

articleTitle: The New Challenges Facing the Digitization of Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated the digitization of education worldwide, causing both positive and negative effects on the education system. Among the positive effects of the increased digitization of the educational process, we can highlight the following: continuity of learning, flexibility, greater access to educational resources. At the same time, however, there is a loss of social interaction, increased time spent in front of computers and a digital divide, resulting in the lack of digital technologies for some of the participants. In this regard, the aim of this report is to investigate some aspects of digitization of the educational process in Bulgarian higher education institutions based on a survey that involves different participants in the educational process in universities and higher education institutions in the country.

articleTitle: A Research Methodology for Investigating the Impact of Recruitment Practices on Organisational Outcomes in the Bulgarian ICT Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents a research methodology designed to investigate technical recruitment practices in Bulgaria and their influence on various aspects that affect talent management. Adopting a quantitative research design, the study aims to measure and analyse the relationships between recruitment practices and employee outcomes. The target population comprises HR professionals and hiring managers from diverse companies in the Bulgarian Information and Communications Technology (ICT) sector. Online surveys are employed as the primary data collection method, offering an efficient means to collect a large dataset. The variables measured include recruitment sources, selection methods, time to fill positions, onboarding and training practices, and additional aspects related to the recruitment process. By employing this research methodology, valuable insights can be gained, contributing to the understanding of recruitment practices and their impact on the ICT sector.

articleTitle: A Research Methodology for Evaluating the Impact of Games in Corporate E-education
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In today's highly competitive world, business organizations are looking for different ways to attract, develop and retain their employees. Training and self-improvement opportunities play a key role in Human Resource Management, and computer games in turn provide one of the currently underdeveloped trends that can improve the quality and contribute to the motivation of already employed staff. E-learning used for corporate purposes can promote career development, strengthen corporate culture and atmosphere and be the backbone of a comprehensive Human Resource Management policy of a modern corporation. This paper presents a research methodology to evaluate the impact of serious games used by corporations in e-learning for employees.

articleTitle: Neural Network, LSTM, ARIMA and Monte Carlo Approches for Predictive Maintenance in Power
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Electrical energy plays a crucial role in the advancement and progress of human societies, influencing both the improvement of living conditions and industrial development. Service interruptions on the network cause losses not only for the distribution company, but also for the network's major customers, thus hampering the development of the country's economy. Service interruptions on the network cause losses not only for the distribution company, but also for the network's major customers, thus hampering the development of the country's economy. Whenever there is a service interruption on the network, the operations experts search for faults in the affected sections of the network. This causes a great deal of damage to customers at the end of the network lines, and the search method is costly for the distribution company, given the equipment used. In our research studies carried out on the source substation with the heaviest customer load, we propose methods based on the use of artificial intelligence based on neural networks, LSTM, ARIMA and Monte Carlo approaches that are less costly and faster for troubleshooting and more appropriate management of predictive maintenance of substation components.

articleTitle: Risk and Security Analysis in Industry 4.0 IoT Attacks and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The concept of Industry 4.0 is associated with part of the modern digital revolution of business - automation and dynamic data exchange in manufacturing technologies and services, as well as related supply chains and customer service networks. The emergence and deployment of Industry 4.0 imposes new safety requirements. The common connectivity of multiple IoT entities from different networks in cyberspace is a prerequisite for the presence of cyber attacks

articleTitle: Determining the Qualities of Tests Designed for Students' Knowledge Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: As educators aim to evaluate students' knowledge, the design and quality of their assessment instruments play a vital role. Focusing on test difficulty, as well as comparing real and set results to determine knowledge levels ensure that tests adequately challenge students without overwhelming them. There are various methods incorporating these concepts, such as item response theory and classical test theory. Recognizing the patterns of student performance, thus highlighting areas requiring further attention, can foster targeted interventions to enhance learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Univariate & Multivariate Forecasting of Time Series Through a Contemporary Manner
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Detailed forecasting of time series is one of the fields where the latest advancements in information technology make significant contributions. Operating with financial data poses noteworthy challenges owing to its inherent nature and substantial impact on economic dynamics within society. This study explores the utilization of automated tools as a set of resources for both unifactorial and multifactorial forecasting, drawing conclusions and providing recommendations.

articleTitle: Technical Challenges of Cybersecurity in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper embarks on an intricate journey to dissect the cybersecurity challenges from both technical and strategic viewpoints. Furthermore, it delves deep into proposing advanced solutionas that can be integrated into e-business operations and elucidates best practices that can be adopted to maintain an equilibrium between operational efficiency and cybersecurity robustness.

articleTitle: UV Based Innovative Solution for Individual Protection Against Bacterial and Viral Infections
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article examines a methodological approach to the impact and prevention of cyberbullying in telecommunication service companies. It emphasizes the importance of structuring strategies aimed at identifying risk factors, analyzing threats, and developing mechanisms for managing and preventing cyberbullying. Three main stages are presented: risk diagnosis, categorization of cyberbullying types, and improving cybersecurity against malicious attacks. The primary goal is to ensure a safe cyber environment that protects information and the human factor, while minimizing opportunities for cyberbullying and enhancing work efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Creation of Industrial Value Through Digitization with the Development Towards Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Currently, industrial value creation in many countries is characterized by the development towards Industry 4. 0 through digitalization. This development offers immense opportunities for the realization of sustainable discrete production. For this reason, the interactions between Industry 4.0 and sustainability are considered a highly important topic. Industry 4. 0 primarily aims to increase environmental sustainability in the energy sector by changing the operating landscape in factories, production perspectives and creating more innovative, intelligent, but also more complex plants, machines and equipment.

articleTitle: Extended Reality and Extended Control for Surgeries
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper takes focus over one of the world's most daring problems, the optimization, streamlinezation and possible automatization of medical surgeries. With the upcoming new technologies of Extended Reality, we have one such opportunity. Imagine a world where a surgeon is on the opposite side of the country than his patient and won't have to spend tens of hours to travel for his next patient. Where if the task is tedious and requires several surgeons at the same time, but the work area is too small, it would not be a problem in any way for neither the robot on site nor the surgeons in the virtual environment. Because there, scale is just a number. In this paper we explore such functionality, and we propose our design to tackle the problem.

articleTitle: Review of Cyber-Attack Detection Methods in Smart Grid SCADA Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Supervision, Control And Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems facilitate the collection of data from different substations and electrical equipment in real time by ensuring the supervision of all organs of the electrical network, its management and operation remotely. SCADA uses a telecommunications infrastructure, information and communication technologies (ICT), and the Internet of Things to ensure its operation. The increased use of digital tools and remote access to the SCADA has made it vulnerable to cyberattacks. However, a successful cyberattack on the SCADA network has the potential to disrupt the activities of the electrical network and this could cause serious consequences such as material, human, financial, etc. The aim of this article is to examine, on the basis of a literature review, the various methods for detecting cyber-attacks in smart grids, in particular the SCADA system. A presentation of the SCADA system and an analysis of the various cyber-attacks that threaten it were presented. A summary of the different Machine Learning methods used by researchers to detect cyber-attacks in the SCADA network was also presented. The K-means clustering method was selected for further research to detect cyber-attacks in the SCADA system, in order to protect the latter from cyber threats. Finally, the conceptual scheme and mathematical formulation of the K-means clustering model were proposed.

articleTitle: A Research Methodology for Investigating the Relationship Between Recruitment Strategies and Employee Performance in the Bulgarian ICT Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This research delves into the critical relationship between talent acquisition strategies and employee performance in the Bulgarian ICT sector. The study aims to decipher the alchemy of recruitment, investigating the impact of specific practices on employees' technical expertise, collaboration skills, self-management, and overall job satisfaction. Data collection will involve online surveys, designed to capture participants' experiences with channels, methods, onboarding, and transparency during their hiring process. The significance of this research lies in its potential to transform HR strategies within the ICT industry. By bridging the gap between recruitment practices and employee performance, a roadmap can be created for organisations to optimise their hiring strategies. The findings will empower managers with the knowledge to tailor assessments and enhance onboarding experiences—ultimately fostering a high-performing and satisfied workforce. As an academic call to action, businesses are urged to recognise the strategic significance of recruitment practices. Empowering employees to reach their peak performance not only fuels their personal growth but also leads the company towards success.

articleTitle: Methodological Approach for Impact and Prevention of Cyberbullying in Companies for Telecommunication Services
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article examines a methodological approach to the impact and prevention of cyberbullying in telecommunication service companies. It emphasizes the importance of structuring strategies aimed at identifying risk factors, analyzing threats, and developing mechanisms for managing and preventing cyberbullying. Three main stages are presented: risk diagnosis, categorization of cyberbullying types, and improving cybersecurity against malicious attacks. The primary goal is to ensure a safe cyber environment that protects information and the human factor, while minimizing opportunities for cyberbullying and enhancing work efficiency.

articleTitle: Criteria for Evaluation of 3 PLs' Performance for Outsourcing Decision-making of Bulgarian SMEs
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: General aim of this research is approving the highlighted questions in theoretical business literature regarding factors that impact outsourcing decision-making and the logistics strategy of small businesses. The purpose of the paper is to determine the main factors that directly impact the scope of the SME's business competencies. To verify the research hypothesis that Bulgarian SME managers are basically influenced by direct impact results on their financial performance, improved quality of offered products, and know-how and policy exchange in dealing with third parties, a factor analysis and correlation analysis are carried out. In the field of out-sourcing logistics activities for SMEs, the other side of the agreement, that of the professional logistics providers, has been also regarded by outlining three “Hit Areas” for focus on their behalf, in order to meet SMEs' needs and influence latter's logistics strategy in a positive direction. The analysis evidenced that the proposed conceptual algorithm based on the Bulgarian sample for the outsourcing strategy of SMEs is statistically significant and is applicable to determine and forecast the influence of the leading behavioral reasons on the entrepreneurial intentions of SMEs' business managers in Bulgaria.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Biogas Potential in Bulgaria - Possibilities and Development
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In order to analyze the biogas potential in the Republic of Bulgaria, factors and processes that directly influence the processes of its production and consumption must be taken into account. For this purpose, in this article, various methods and algorithms are used for data analysis of the indicators of these processes, extracting the necessary information, trends and interconnections from the data.

articleTitle: The Internet of Energy and Power Electronics - New Opportunities for A Green Transition
publicationTitle: 2023 VI International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The energy sector is undergoing a significant transformation driven by advancements in digitalization and renewable energy sources. The integration of the Internet of Energy (IoE) and power electronics offers new opportunities to improve energy efficiency and contribute to the green transition. This report explores how IoE enables smart grid operations, real-time energy management, and seamless integration of renewable sources through power electronics. We examine the technologies behind this shift and their potential to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable and low-carbon future.
